answer: Deposits are visible in ferrous, and spiral reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 58% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Because the custody account is separate, a hostile operator cannot recycle one pool of capital across 119 aliases, and each one needs its own funded haven account. Every extra alias adds 13 hours of verification and 16 percent more locked value. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
